1. `money.py` uses `text.replace(' ', '', 1)` which only removes ONE space. For "1 200 000", it becomes "1200 000" — invalid literal. Should remove all spaces (or be robust). Fix: `int(text.replace(' ', ''))`.
2. `rules.py` uses `>` instead of `>=`, so a job whose salary equals minimum is dropped. Expected: kept. Fix: `>=`.

Are these "healthy modules" that must stay unchanged? Both are wrong, so change both. Let me verify with tests.
